jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR
 We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.

You will work across multiple companies and domains inside the group — including energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — helping build and operate the cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, automation platforms, and internal developer tooling that power our next generation of software and AI-enabled systems.

We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineer with strong infrastructure and automation skills who wants to help design highly autonomous, resilient, and scalable systems. This role is not limited to maintaining infrastructure: you will actively shape how engineering, operations, AI automation, and internal platforms evolve across the organization.
 About the Team
 We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.
 We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and working with people who make the team better.
 We appreciate engineers who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and AI-assisted development.
 What You’ll Do

• Build and maintain AWS-based infrastructure using services such as ECS, Fargate, EC2, Lambda, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, IAM, and related services

• Design and manage Kubernetes-based workloads and containerized environments

• Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or AWS CDK

• Build CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows using GitHub Actions and related tooling

• Create infrastructure automation systems focused on scalability, reliability, self-healing, and operational efficiency

• Improve observability, monitoring, alerting, deployment safety, and operational tooling

• Collaborate closely with software engineers, data engineers, and AI teams to enable fast and reliable delivery

• Develop AI-enabled operational automation, internal agents, MCP-based integrations, and autonomous workflows to reduce manual operational overhead

• Help evolve the organization toward a more autonomous engineering and infrastructure stack

• Evaluate and adopt modern cloud, platform engineering, and AI-native infrastructure approaches where they provide real leverage

What We Offer

• A high-autonomy role with direct influence on what gets built

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have 4+ years working with cloud infrastructure and production systems, particularly on AWS

• You are comfortable designing and operating containerized workloads using Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, or similar technologies

• You have strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or equivalent tools

• You have experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems, preferably with GitHub Actions

• You think in terms of automation first, and naturally look for ways to eliminate repetitive operational work

• You are comfortable debugging distributed systems, infrastructure failures, networking issues, and deployment problems in production environments

• You care about reliability, scalability, observability, and developer experience — not just “keeping servers running”

• You actively use AI coding and automation tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP-enabled workflows, or similar — and are interested in how AI changes infrastructure and operations workflows

• You make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, maintainability, operational simplicity, and engineering rigor

• You enjoy working across infrastructure, software, automation, and internal tooling rather than staying inside a narrow operational silo

Experience with platform engineering, Kubernetes operators, observability stacks, event-driven systems, internal developer platforms, LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, or large-scale automation systems is a strong plus.

You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering ability, adaptability, curiosity, and a strong automation mindset matter much more.

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

TL;DR
 We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-style environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.
 You will work on a wide variety of projects across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — not as an external consultant, but as part of the group itself, with the ownership and continuity of an internal product and engineering team.
 You will build AI-enabled products, agents, automation systems, evaluation pipelines, and backend infrastructure that remove operational bottlenecks, improve decision-making, and create leverage across the business.
 This is a great role for an engineer who is excited about applying modern AI systems to real business problems, cares about shipping reliable products, and wants to grow quickly alongside experienced teammates.
 About the Team
 We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.
 We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and working with people who make the team better.
 We appreciate engineers who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem-solving, and AI-assisted development.
 What You’ll Do
 Design and build AI-powered systems that make the organization faster and smarter:

• LLM-powered applications, agents, assistants, and automation workflows

• Retrieval-augmented generation systems, internal knowledge tools, and document intelligence pipelines

• Evaluation, monitoring, and feedback loops for AI systems in production

• Backend services and APIs that connect AI capabilities to real business workflows

• Integrations across internal and third-party systems, often where the hard part is understanding the domain, not the model

• Data pipelines and tooling that support experimentation, deployment, and continuous improvement

• Engineering tooling that improves how we build, test, and ship AI-enabled products

You will work with more experienced engineers and domain experts to understand business problems, design pragmatic AI solutions, and build, test, ship, evaluate, and improve systems over time.
 You will not just experiment in notebooks. You will be encouraged to understand the domain, ask hard questions, suggest improvements, and take on increasing ownership of production systems.
 What We Offer

• A role with real ownership, support, and room to grow

• Exposure to a broad variety of technical and business problems

• The opportunity to build practical AI systems used inside a diversified international group

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• Competitive compensation and benefits

• Flexible working hours and a remote-first setup, with hybrid options where applicable

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have built or contributed to LLM-powered applications, agents, RAG systems, automation tools, or similar AI-enabled products

• You are comfortable working with APIs, databases, backend services, and modern cloud-based infrastructure

• You understand that building useful AI systems is not just about prompting models, but also about product thinking, data, evaluation, reliability, and integration

• You can take a messy business problem and turn it into a practical technical solution

• You make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, cost, latency, and maintainability, and can explain why

• You are curious about how models behave in real workflows and care about measuring whether the system actually works

• You use AI coding tools daily — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and have opinions about where they help and where they don’t

• You enjoy working close to the business and take the time to understand a process before modeling or automating it

Experience with LLM APIs, open-source models, vector databases, embeddings, evaluation frameworks, agent frameworks, MCP servers, data warehouses such as Redshift, Postgres, FastAPI, or AWS-based services is a strong plus.
 You do not need experience with every technology we use. Strong engineering ability, adaptability, product judgment, and willingness to learn matter much more.
 If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
TL;DR
 We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a globally diversified group.
 We are looking for an Operations Research Engineer : someone who works close to business teams, understands messy operational and planning problems, develops optimization models and algorithms to solve them efficiently, and turns solutions into practical tools used by a diverse range of stakeholders.
 You will work across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — not as an external consultant, but as part of the group itself, with the ownership and continuity of an internal product and engineering team.
 You will identify opportunities, prototype optimization-based tools, evaluate impact, and help deploy solutions that remove bottlenecks, improve decision-making, and create leverage across the business.
 About the Team
 We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly, with AI being already part of our daily workflow.
 We care about building solutions that work in the real world: useful tools, reliable and smart decisions, better workflows, and systems that create measurable impact.
 We appreciate people who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and working directly with users to understand how things actually get done.
 What You’ll Do

• Design, build, test, and deploy optimization-based solutions for a variety of business applications

• Collaborate closely with business and technical teams to understand needs, formalize optimization problems, prototype solutions, measure impact, and iterate — not just execute predefined specs

• Develop linear, nonlinear, and mixed-integer programming models, along with heuristic and stochastic optimization methods, to enhance operational efficiency and decision-making

• Ensure the robustness, scalability, and interpretability of optimization solutions deployed in production environments

• Research and evaluate emerging technologies and methodologies in operations research and mathematical optimization to drive innovation

What We Offer

• A high-autonomy role with direct influence on how optimization is applied across the group

• Real business problems with visible impact

• Modern AI-assisted tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains

• Competitive compensation, reflecting the technical depth and impact you can bring to the team, plus bonus. For roles based in Italy, the salary range is €45,000–€60,000.

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup

You’re Probably a Fit If

• You have a master’s degree with at least 2-3 years of relevant experience, or a Ph.D. in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

• You have in-depth knowledge of mathematical programming (linear, integer, etc.), various heuristic and metaheuristic approaches, and stochastic optimization methods

• You are proficient in optimization software (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, open solvers) and have strong programming skills in Python or other languages relevant to optimization and modeling

• You have experience in building and solving large-scale optimization models and the ability to communicate insights and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders

• You enjoy working close to users and business teams, understanding how work happens, and turning messy problems into useful optimization-based solutions

• You have proven track record of implementing optimization-based solutions in real-world settings and/or in publishing optimization-based research in Operations Research related journals

• You are pragmatic about using AI in the daily workflow: excited by what it can do, but aware of its limitations, failure modes, and the importance of good evaluation

Experience with forecasting and machine learning, structured and unstructured data, simulation, database systems, AWS, deploying tools in production environments or complex operational domains is a plus.
 You do not need experience with every technology and optimization method. Curiosity, analytical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to turn optimization into practical business impact matter much more.
 If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

• Concevoir, construire, tester et déployer des solutions basées sur l'optimisation pour diverses applications commerciales

• Un rôle de haute autonomie avec une influence directe sur la façon dont l'optimisation est appliquée dans l'ensemble du groupe

• Outils modernes assistés par l'IA et temps pour explorer de nouvelles technologies et approches

• Un environnement de collaboration rapide avec des gens talentueux et ambitieux

• Un large éventail de défis techniques et commerciaux dans différents domaines

• Rémunération et avantages concurrentiels

• Temps de travail flexible et configuration du travail hybride

• Vous avez une maîtrise avec au moins 2-3 ans d'expérience pertinente, ou un doctorat en recherche opérationnelle, mathématiques appliquées, génie industriel, ou un domaine connexe.

jobs.description:
TL;DR
 We are expanding Duferco's Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving engineering team operating in a startup-style environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.
 We are reimagining the core systems behind our industrial operations, built for a world where AI is part of every step of software development.
 As a Senior Software Engineer with a systems architect mindset, you will help shape how these systems are designed, how they stay reliable, and how we build software with AI.
 We are looking for someone curious and pragmatic, who enjoys shaping solutions from the ground up and is motivated by the opportunity to have a lasting impact on how critical systems are designed and built.
 About the Team
 We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.
 We care about building things well, shipping systems that create leverage, and working with people who make the team better.
 We appreciate engineers who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem-solving, and raising the standard for everyone around them.
 What You'll Do
 Help define what modern, AI-native core systems look like, and build them with the team:

• Design the architecture of our next-generation operational systems: domain boundaries, data ownership, and integration contracts.

• Make correctness part of the design, so that transactions and state stay consistent under concurrency, retries, and partial failures.

• Improve our software development lifecycle for AI-assisted engineering: how specifications, tests, code review, and verification work when agents write much of the code.

• Develop and promote engineering best practices, reference implementations, and reusable components that make future systems faster and safer to build.

• Shape how we gain confidence in critical systems: testing strategies, validation approaches, and observability.

• Contribute to technical decisions with long-term impact, and share the trade-offs so the team can build on them.

• Stay hands-on: build critical parts, review the work of humans and agents, and adjust the design when production shows something new.

You will collaborate with Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and domain experts, from problem definition through deployment and operation.
 Your responsibility goes beyond delivering features. You will learn the domain, challenge existing assumptions, and help decide how the next generation of our core systems should work and how our team should build them.
 What We Offer

• A role with real ownership and influence on the architecture and engineering culture of the team

• The chance to help shape how industrial core systems are built in an AI-native way

• Exposure to a broad variety of technical and business problems inside a diversified international group

• Modern AI-assisted engineering tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches

• A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people

• Competitive compensation, reflecting the technical depth and impact you can bring to the team, plus bonus. For roles based in Italy, the salary range is €50,000–€65,000.

• Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup.

You're Probably a Fit If

• You have designed, built, and operated backend systems in production, and contributed to the architectural decisions behind them.

• You reason naturally about system boundaries, data models, transactions, consistency, and failure scenarios, and you design for them from the start.

• You have clear ideas on how software should be built, and you enjoy refining them together with your team.

• You have helped improve how a team works: its practices, its tooling, or its development process.

• You turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical direction and make deliberate trade-offs between speed, quality, and complexity.

• You use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor daily, and you think about how they change design, implementation, testing, and review.

• You enjoy understanding the business problem as well as solving the technical one.

• You typically have 5–10 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering.

Experience with any of the following is a strong plus:

• Postgres, Python, or FastAPI.

• Distributed or event-driven systems.

• Legacy modernization, ERP or MES platforms, or complex operational domains.

You do not need experience with every technology or domain we work with. Strong engineering judgment, systems thinking, curiosity, and willingness to learn matter much more.
 If you want to help shape how critical systems are designed and built in the AI era, we'd love to hear from you
